objective: Close X5 Metal/fused-attention gate as blocked/fail-closed: no GPU success claim, no silent CPU fallback, and no production feature flag until a packaged accelerator proves a benchmark win.

criteria.promise: The X5 probe requires explicit MODEL_PATH and LITERT_LM_SOURCE_DIR, macOS arm64, an already-built advanced CLI, GPU backend output containing the sentinel, and exits blocked instead of falling back to CPU when the accelerator is absent.
The X5 docs record the upstream accelerator-packaging blocker and require future CPU/GPU output equivalence plus target M1/8 GB benchmark evidence before reopening production work.
No production provider, feature flag, or Package.swift dependency exposes Metal/LiteRT fused attention to users.

verification_gates.procedure: Run bash -n on Scripts/spike-litert-lm-x5.sh and inspect its explicit environment requirements and blocked exit path.
verification_gates.expected: The probe never downloads, never silently falls back to CPU, and labels failed GPU output as blocked/rejected.
The blocker, future equivalence requirement and target-machine benchmark gate are documented.

verification_gates.procedure: Search production sources and Package.swift for Metal/LiteRT/fused attention exposure.
verification_gates.expected: No production provider/feature flag/dependency is registered.

recon_evidence: X5 docs and probe were inspected. This ticket accepts a blocked fail-closed state, not Metal production integration. The absent official GPU/Metal accelerator dylibs are a known blocker documented in the spike docs, not an unresolved unknown for this closure.

first_checkpoint.evidence: Shell syntax check, docs inspection and production source absence search.
